name: dsh-zhuang-fangyi
description: 庄方宜主题 for DeepSeek Harness —— 接入官方 ctx.theme 体系（8 套配色 × 浅色/深色完整适配），附皮肤层（观测台官方右栏标签页 + 浮层兜底 / 头像气泡重绘）、官方素材壁纸与强调色色相自选。官方素材量化取色，非官方同人作品。

scripts.test: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node src/contrast.js && node tools/gen-wallpapers.mjs --check && node tools/test-client.mjs && node tools/check-manifest.mjs

capability.invocation: Boot the profile's Web GUI and open Settings → 庄方宜, then read the document: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-zf-wallpaper') names the active wallpaper, getAttribute('data-zf-font') the typeface preset, getAttribute('data-zf-font-scale') the text scale, and document.body.getAttribute('data-zf-depth') the material depth. Code blocks resolve --shiki-background to the theme's code-block colour (getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('pre.shiki')).backgroundColor is never transparent). The observation tab registers as 'dsh-zhuang-fangyi-observation' through sidebarRightTabs.
capability.expected: The host half registers 8 style presets × 2 schemes = 16 themes into the shell's own theme registry, and injects the first frame (theme tokens for the boot card plus a cover) while the document is still parsing, so the built-in [data-dsh-boot] card renders in theme colours rather than its defaults. Switching a preset changes the surface lightness baseline, chroma, border strength, material depth and typeface together — measurable as a base-colour luminance spread of >=0.03 (light) / >=0.002 (dark) across the eight presets, with every pair differing on at least one of hue / chroma / lightness so no two presets look alike. Code blocks, status colours and the boot card all follow the active theme.
